# WhatIs - Knowledge Base

> A multi-subject educational knowledge base covering K-12 academics, programming, philosophy, and science with community-driven content.

WhatIs.eokultv.com is a comprehensive learning platform that aggregates educational guides, study materials, and interactive content across diverse subjects including mathematics, language arts, science, history, and computer science. The site features community member contributions, user authentication, and curated educational resources for learners of all grade levels.

## Key Topics

- Educational Content
- Study Guides
- Elementary Mathematics
- English Language Arts
- Kindergarten Learning
- Grade-Level Education
- Knowledge Base
- Student Guides
- Python Programming
- Computer Science
- Philosophy
- eokultv Community
- Interactive Worksheets
- Q&A Format
- Tutorial Articles

## Core Platform

- [WhatIs - Knowledge Base](https://whatis.eokultv.com): Multi-subject knowledge base with educational content on Python, philosophy, and science.
- [Log In / Join Community](https://whatis.eokultv.com/auth.php): User authentication, login, and community registration portal.
- [Community Members](https://whatis.eokultv.com/members): Community member profiles, leaderboard, and contributor rankings.

## Programming & Computer Science

- [Master Java Interfaces vs. Abstract Classes: Easy Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/668438-interfaces-vs-abstract-classes-in-java-key-differences): Programming guide comparing Java interfaces and abstract classes with examples.
- [Easy Saving Files Quiz: Kindergarten CS](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/699778-saving-files-quiz-test-your-kindergarten-computer-science-knowledge): Kindergarten computer science guide on file management and saving files.
- [What is Canva? Your Ultimate Guide to Social Media Design](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/16265-what-is-canva-and-how-can-it-help-your-social-media-content): Guide to Canva graphic design tool for social media content creation.
- [Master Netiquette: The Ultimate Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/646189-is-netiquette-safe-protecting-yourself-and-others-online): Guide to netiquette, online safety, digital etiquette, and cybersecurity basics.

## Elementary Mathematics

- [Master Alligator Math: A Grade 1 Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/60856-understanding-alligator-mouth-symbols-for-comparing-numbers-grade-1-lesson): Grade 1 lesson on comparing numbers using alligator mouth symbols with practice.
- [Master Math: Counters & Blocks Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/57996-counters-and-blocks-math-problems-worksheets-for-first-grade): First grade math guide using counters and blocks for addition and subtraction.
- [Master Distributive Property: Easy Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/70184-how-to-use-the-distributive-property-to-break-apart-numbers-for-multiplication): Elementary math guide on distributive property for multiplication and mental math.
- [Master Charts & Graphs: Easy Guide for Kids!](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/650173-real-life-examples-of-using-charts-and-graphs-for-kids): Educational guide on charts and graphs with real-world examples and practice quiz.

## Language Arts & Reading

- [Master Kindergarten Reading: List vs. Story Explained Simply](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/570045-difference-between-a-list-and-a-story-in-kindergarten-reading): Kindergarten reading guide distinguishing lists from stories with examples.
- [Master First Sound Words: K-ELA Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/567946-common-first-sound-words-for-k-ela-learning): Kindergarten ELA guide on phonemic awareness and letter-sound correspondence.
- [Master Grade 3 ELA: Constructive Feedback Worksheets](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/520386-constructive-feedback-worksheets-for-grade-3-ela-practice): Grade 3 ELA worksheet on constructive feedback and peer review writing skills.

## Science & Natural Studies

- [Chloroplasts: Structure, Function & Photosynthesis Explained](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/6058-chloroplasts-structure-and-function): Biology guide on chloroplast structure, photosynthesis, and plant cell organelles.

## Philosophy & Social Studies

- [Master the Sublime: Burke's Influence on Literature](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/402535-the-influence-of-edmund-burkes-a-philosophical-enquiry-on-literary-interpretations-of-the-sublime): Guide to Edmund Burke's philosophical aesthetics and influence on Romantic poetry.
- [Master Gerrymandering: An Easy Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/350552-gerrymandering-what-is-the-effect-on-voting-turnout): Educational guide on gerrymandering, voting districts, and electoral manipulation.
- [Master Japanese Expansionism: The Ultimate Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/363839-documents-related-to-japanese-expansionism-in-the-1930s): Historical study guide on Japanese expansionism, WWII, and militarism.
- [Master Grid Systems: The Ultimate Guide](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/219640-how-do-grid-systems-help-us-navigate-and-find-places): Guide to grid systems, navigation, coordinate systems, and cartography.

## Optional

- [Master Healthy Treats: The Ultimate Quiz](https://whatis.eokultv.com/wiki/132286-true-or-false-a-grade-1-quiz-on-healthy-treats): Grade 1 health education quiz on nutrition basics and healthy food choices.
